caption: The drawing depicts the silhouette of a rooster, rendered in a stippled, dark gray or black tone on a light beige background. The rooster is shown in profile, facing left, and features a prominent comb with multiple points on its head, a beak, a wattle hanging beneath the head, a rounded chest, two short legs, and a pronounced, jagged tail extending to the right with several elongated feather shapes. The entire shape is outlined and filled in a uniform dark shade, with some dotting and textural variations within the body. The lower left corner contains the name “Rollington Campbell,” and the upper right corner includes a ruler scale marked “Inches” with divisions from 0 to 3. The drawing is set within a single-line rectangular border, and there are some brownish stains in the upper left and right corners of the background.
title: Weather Vane Cock
